bull.probability_evidence: Every valuation multiple sits in the bottom fifth of RMD's own 5-year range (P/FCF 2nd percentile, P/E 15th, P/B 14th; factsheet Valuation table) while ROIC (26.2% vs 22.0% FY22), gross margin (61.6%) and operating margin (34.0%) keep expanding (factsheet Quality table), and management says GLP-1 scripts are adding to, not displacing, PAP therapy starts (Q4 2026 earnings call transcript, https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/rmd/transcripts/638539-q4-2026/) — the basis cited for a re-rating toward the 5y median multiple.

target_band.cite: Re-rating the current TTM EPS/FCF-per-share/book-value-per-share (from price $225.98 / current multiples P/E 21.7x, P/FCF 19.3x, P/B 4.9x) to each multiple's own 5y median (P/E 27.5x→$286.4, P/FCF 22.7x→$265.8, P/B 6.3x→$290.5; factsheet Valuation table) spans ~$24.8; half that spread ÷ the $286 target ≈ 4.3%.

base.probability_evidence: Management's guided FY2027 core revenue growth of 5%-7% (Morgan Stanley Global Healthcare Conference transcript, 2026-09-15, https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/rmd/transcripts/740972-morgan-stanley-24th-annual-global-healthcare-conference/) with buybacks (shares -0.87% YoY, factsheet Other table) supporting modest per-share growth at a roughly unchanged multiple is the path with no re-rating catalyst in either direction, hence the modal 50% weight.

target_band.cite: Holding each multiple at its current level (P/E 21.7x, P/FCF 19.3x, P/B 4.9x; factsheet Valuation table) reproduces the current price of $225.98 under every anchor by construction — zero disagreement between valuation anchors for the no-re-rating base case; the $232 target's small increment over $225.98 reflects per-share growth from earnings and buybacks (note §5 Capital allocation), not valuation-anchor dispersion.

bear.probability_evidence: FY2027 guidance already missed once on suspended ventilator sales and cost pressure (Reuters, 2026-08-07, https://www.reuters.com/legal/litigation/resmed-shares-tumble-weak-2027-sales-forecast-eclipses-quarterly-profit-beat-2026-08-07/), short interest is elevated and rising (10.16% of float, +11.0% MoM, factsheet Other/News tables), and Q1 FY2027 earnings land Oct 29, 2026 (factsheet Price table) — the evaluation's explicit bear catalyst is a second disappointment re-rating the multiple to its 5y minimum.

target_band.cite: Re-rating the current TTM per-share metrics to each multiple's own 5y minimum (P/E 18.5x→$192.7, P/FCF 17.1x→$200.2, P/B 4.3x→$198.3; factsheet Valuation table) spans ~$7.6; half that spread ÷ the $193 target ≈ 2.0%.
